messages:
maria: Heads-up — spotted sustained bursts from a few tenants in us-west-2 (az-b) around 02:10 UTC. Shared GPU tail latency jumped to ~2.1s, several preemptible slots got evicted. Logs: https://rwd/logs/ingress/3076543210

aj: Which tenants? noisy neighbor again? :grimacing:

maria: t-88 and t-14. pattern looks like tight loop of small-model embedding + repeated prefix misses. KV cache hit rate dropped 22% for that shard.

ryan: ran a quick query — t-88 had a burst of 600 short requests in 60s, mostly embedding API. Bandwidth + pcie utilization spiked concurrently. Seems client-side retry loop amplified it.

devon: Proposal: add a "burst-surge circuit breaker" for shared pools. Quick summary: detect short-window request bursts per-tenant, then do a temporary routing action: either shard into a warm dedicated spare slice or apply tokenized throttle for Xs. Keep it soft (probabilistic) so we don't hard-fail prod tenants.

aj: +1. Need cost/chargeback guardrails if we move traffic to dedicated slices. Also avoid rapid flip-flopping (flapping).

maria: Draft config (for discussion):
```yaml
circuit_breaker:
  window_seconds: 30
  burst_threshold_qps: 150
  sustained_threshold: 3   # number of windows
  action: route_to_spare | prob_throttle
  throttle_pct: 60        # if action == prob_throttle
  cooldown_seconds: 300   # after action, suppress re-routes for this tenant
  logging: sample_per_minute: 10
```

ryan: can we add an egress/NIC shaping fallback too? If pcie or egress saturates, we should apply nic-police then route. That reduces spillover effects.

devon: yep. operator knobs: prefer route_to_spare for infra customers with commit; prob_throttle for free-tier. Also we should bump KV cache TTL for suspected hot prefixes while in circuit-breaker to reduce misses.

aj: ops/QA ask: we need a canary rollout in a single AZ, and a manual emergency off switch. Also a metric: false_positive_rate and reroute_cost_estimate.

ryan: I'll open a PR with the feature flag + canary pipeline. Plan: canary in us-west-2-azb for 48h, watch tail latency, preemptible eviction rate, and billing delta.

infra-bot: deploy-plan created: feature-flag:cb-burst-surge -> canary(us-west-2-azb) rollout at 2024-10-02T15:00Z. Assigned -> @ryan. :white_check_mark:

maria: Awesome. Also flagging product: potential customer impact if we route to dedicated (cost). @aj can you coordinate billing tag logic?

aj: On it. I'll draft cost tags + alerts for >$X reroute spend in 1h.

maria: Thanks all — let's keep thread for PR link + post-canary metrics. :thumbsup:
